class S2D4P.architectures.normalized_flows.MAF(hidden_dim=16, base_network=<class 'S2D4P.architectures.normalized_flows.FCNN'>)

Bases: flowABC

Masked autoregressive flow transformation.

Each latent dimension is transformed using location and log-scale parameters conditioned on preceding latent dimensions and, optionally, external conditioning features.

Parameters:

  • hidden_dim (int) – Number of hidden features used by the parameter networks.

  • base_network (type[nn.Module]) – Network class used to predict location and log-scale parameters.

build(dim, condition_size=None)

Build the autoregressive transformation.

A parameter network is created for each latent dimension after the first. For an unconditional flow, the first dimension uses directly learned parameters. For a conditional flow, its parameters are predicted from the conditioning features.

Parameters:

  • dim (int) – Number of latent dimensions transformed by the flow.

  • condition_size (int | None) – Number of conditioning features. If None, the flow is unconditional.

Returns:

This flow instance with its parameter networks constructed.

Return type:

MAF

forward(x, condition=None)

Apply the autoregressive flow transformation.

Each output dimension is standardized using parameters predicted from the preceding input dimensions. The transformed feature order is reversed before being returned.

Parameters:

  • x (torch.Tensor) – Input samples with shape (batch, dim).

  • condition (torch.Tensor | None) – Conditioning features required by a conditional flow.

Returns:

Transformed samples and the forward log-determinant for each sample.

Return type:

tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]

Raises:

ValueError – If the flow was constructed as conditional but no conditioning features are provided.

inverse(z, condition=None)

Apply the inverse autoregressive flow transformation.

Input feature order is reversed before each original dimension is reconstructed sequentially from previously reconstructed dimensions.

Parameters:

  • z (torch.Tensor) – Transformed samples with shape (batch, dim).

  • condition (torch.Tensor | None) – Conditioning features required by a conditional flow.

Returns:

Inverse-transformed samples and the inverse log-determinant for each sample.

Return type:

tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]

Raises:

ValueError – If the flow was constructed as conditional but no conditioning features are provided.

reset_parameters()

Initialize the learnable first-dimension parameters.

The location and log-scale parameters are initialized from a uniform distribution.

class S2D4P.architectures.normalized_flows.NormalizedFlowModel(config: NormalizedFlowConfig, latent_size, condition_size: int = None)

Bases: flowABC

Apply a sequence of normalizing-flow transformations.

Individual flow steps are evaluated in configuration order during the forward transformation and in reverse order during the inverse transformation. Log-determinants are accumulated across all steps.

Parameters:

  • config (NormalizedFlowConfig) – Configuration defining the sequence of flow transformations.

  • latent_size (int) – Number of latent dimensions transformed by each flow.

  • condition_size (int | None) – Number of conditioning features supplied to each flow. If None, the flow is unconditional.

forward(x, condition=None)

Apply the normalizing flows in forward order.

Parameters:

  • x (torch.Tensor) – Input samples with shape (batch, latent_size).

  • condition (torch.Tensor | None) – Optional conditioning features supplied to each flow.

Returns:

Transformed samples and accumulated forward log-determinants.

Return type:

flowOutput

inverse(z, condition=None)

Apply the normalizing flows in reverse order.

Parameters:

  • z (torch.Tensor) – Transformed samples with shape (batch, latent_size).

  • condition (torch.Tensor | None) – Optional conditioning features supplied to each inverse flow.

Returns:

Inverse-transformed samples and accumulated inverse log-determinants.

Return type:

flowOutput

class S2D4P.architectures.normalized_flows.RealNVP(hidden_dim=16, base_network=<class 'S2D4P.architectures.normalized_flows.FCNN'>)

Bases: flowABC

Real-valued non-volume-preserving coupling flow.

The latent representation is divided into two parts that are transformed sequentially using learned translation and log-scale functions. The coupling networks can optionally depend on external conditioning features.

Parameters:

  • hidden_dim (int) – Number of hidden features used by the coupling networks.

  • base_network (type[nn.Module]) – Network class used to construct translation and log-scale functions.

build(dim, condition_size=None)

Build the RealNVP coupling networks.

Translation and log-scale networks are constructed for both coupling transformations and optionally include conditioning features in their inputs.

Parameters:

  • dim (int) – Number of latent dimensions transformed by the flow.

  • condition_size (int | None) – Number of conditioning features. If None, the flow is unconditional.

Returns:

This flow instance with its coupling networks constructed.

Return type:

RealNVP

Translation and log-scale networks are constructed for both coupling transformations and optionally include conditioning features in their inputs.

inverse(z, condition=None)

Apply the inverse RealNVP coupling transformation.

The two coupling transformations are inverted in reverse dependency order to recover the original latent samples.

Parameters:

  • z (torch.Tensor) – Transformed samples with shape (batch, dim).

  • condition (torch.Tensor | None) – Conditioning features required by a conditional flow.

Returns:

Inverse-transformed samples and the inverse log-determinant for each sample.

Return type:

tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]

Raises:

ValueError – If the flow was constructed as conditional but no conditioning features are provided.
